name: Ars Uberia: Uberia's Lament, or The Diaries of Dartanias Pendleton III
source:
Wystan Pendleton is a naive, young college student, unlucky in life and love. He seeks to change his fortune by moving in with his grandmother, attending a prestigious university, and hopefully finding the girl of his dreams. But his life is forever altered when he finds himself in the land of Uberia, a mystical land of magic and mystery where he must uncover the dark secrets that control not only Uberia, but the very world he considered himself a part of.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1631649291/ars-uberia-modern-fantasy-visual-novel]Kickstarter page[/url]]
translation:
维斯坦·彭德尔顿（Wystan Pendleton）是一位天真的年轻大学生，在生活和爱情上都很不幸。他试图通过搬去与祖母同住、进入一所著名大学并希望找到他的梦想女孩来改变自己的命运。但当他发现自己身处乌贝里亚的土地时，他的生活发生了永远的改变，这是一个充满魔法和神秘的神秘土地，在那里他必须揭开黑暗的秘密，这些秘密不仅控制着乌贝里亚，还控制着他认为自己属于其中的世界。

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1631649291/ars-uberia-modern-fantasy-visual-novel]Kickstarter页面[/url]]
